#  Cosmic’s SMP +

**Cosmic’s SMP +** is a lightweight vanilla+ Minecraft modpack designed for smooth multiplayer survival, optimized PvP, and high performance. It enhances FPS, stability, and gameplay responsiveness while keeping the original Minecraft experience intact.

Perfect for SMP servers and friends who want a clean, fast, and stable survival world without unnecessary changes.

Cosmic’s SMP + is made to keep Minecraft feeling vanilla while improving the overall experience with better performance, smoother gameplay, and extra convenience.


Cosmic’s SMP+ is a lightweight and optimized Minecraft modpack made to upgrade your survival multiplayer experience. It improves performance, adds quality-of-life features, and keeps everything smooth and simple.

It’s designed for easy SMP gameplay with friends, giving you better FPS, less lag, and a more enjoyable world without changing the core Minecraft feel too much.

<details>
 <summary>Extensive Features, Click To See!</summary>
- Enhanced FPS and reduced lag

- Improved multiplayer stability

- Cleaner UI and smoother menus

- Better chunk loading and memory usage

- PvP-friendly optimization

- Lightweight and easy to run

- Designed for long SMP worlds

- Balanced vanilla+ experience
  </details>

<details>
1. <summary>PVP Mod List Click To See!</summary>

- Sodium – High FPS rendering engine  
  
- Lithium – Optimizes game logic and tick performance  

- Starlight – Faster lighting system  
  
- FerriteCore – Reduces memory (RAM) usage  
  
- Krypton – Improves multiplayer networking  
  
- Dynamic FPS – Reduces background lag and resource usage  

</details>

This pack is focused on stability and clean gameplay. New mods, tweaks, and quality-of-life updates may be added in future versions based on community suggestions.
